 Montgomery County District Court
 Cause No. 2025-CV-0009
 Todd Lee, Plaintiff, v. Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance, Defendant
 Oral Deposition of Todd Lee
Date:
October 21, 2025
Location:
Offices of Gardner & Morris Law Group
Examining attorney:
Marilyn Fox, Ashford & Lyle LLP
Defending attorney:
Garrett Wallace, Gardner & Morris Law Group
Q: Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not put my full name in a transcript, but you can call me the plaintiff.
Q: Understood. Where were you living at the time of the accident?
A: In Katy, Texas, in a townhome off one of the main parkways.
Q: Walk me through what you were doing that afternoon before the collision.
A: I had finished a shift and was driving home. Traffic was stop-and-go on the feeder road, the kind where everyone starts and
stops every few seconds.
Q: What happened when the vehicle stopped?
A: I had come to a complete stop behind a sedan at a light. I felt a hard jolt from behind. My head snapped back and then forward,
and my seatbelt locked across my chest.
Q: Did you get out of the car at the scene?
A: I got out, but my neck felt tight right away and my shoulders were burning. I sat on the curb until the officer arrived.
Q: Did you go to a doctor after the accident?
A: The same evening, I went to an urgent care clinic. They took X-rays and told me I had whiplash and muscle strain in my neck
and upper back.
Q: Have you received any further treatment since then?
A: Yes. I started physical therapy about two weeks later, three times a week at first, and then twice a week. I still do exercises at
home every morning. My primary care doctor also prescribed medication for the muscle spasms.
Q: How have you been feeling day to day?
A: Some days are manageable, but on others I wake up with a stiff neck and headaches that start at the base of my skull. Turning
my head to check my blind spot when I merge is harder than it used to be.
Q: Has the injury affected your work?
A: I'm on my feet for most of my shift, and I had to ask for lighter duties for about a month. Sitting for long periods in the car is
uncomfortable, so I have shortened my longer drives.
Q: Have you been able to do your regular hobbies?
A: I used to play recreational volleyball on weekends. I haven't been able to return to that yet because lifting my arms overhead
causes pain across my upper back.
Q: Do you have any prior injuries to your neck or back?
A: Nothing serious. I had a minor sprain years ago that resolved with rest.
</page>
